title.zh: 怎样从油滴的运动称出电荷？
title.en: How can a moving oil drop reveal its charge?

description.zh: 跟踪同一颗未知油滴，用终速和电压反求电荷，再以密立根固定计时记录检验共同小增量。
description.en: Follow one unknown drop, infer charge from speed and voltage, then test recurring increments against Millikan’s fixed timing records.

narration.durationStatus: Measured shared recording duration; no time stretching

cues.title: 一个亮点，怎样称出重量？
cues.titleEn: How can a bright spot reveal weight?
cues.caption: 匀速下落给出阻力与重量的约束。
cues.captionEn: Steady falling constrains drag and weight.
cues.zh: 怎样称出一颗油滴的电荷？先别给它指定几个电子。看这颗亮点：没有电场，它匀速走过半毫米，用了大约六点八七秒。匀速意味着什么？不是没有重力，而是空气阻力已经平衡了重力减去浮力。亮点是散射像，不能拿它的宽度直接量半径。我们换一个办法：让三个半径候选面对同一个观测速率。小的候选，阻力大于有效重力，会慢下来；大的候选会加速。只有中间这个约零点八微米的半径，能保持眼前的匀速。结合密度、黏度和空气滑移修正，就得到这颗教学油滴的有效重量。电荷还没有进入这次推断。
cues.en: How could we weigh the charge on a tiny oil drop? Do not assign it an electron count. Watch one bright spot: with no electric field, it travels half a millimetre steadily in about six point eight seven seconds. Steady motion does not mean gravity has disappeared. Air drag now balances gravity minus buoyancy. The spot is scattered light, so its width is not a direct radius measurement. Instead, test three radius candidates against the same observed speed. The small candidate has too much drag for its effective weight and would slow down. The large one would accelerate. Only the middle radius, about zero point eight micrometres, permits steady falling. Density, viscosity and the air-slip correction then give this teaching drop’s effective weight. Its charge has not entered that inference.

cues.title: 电压怎样把电荷变成可测量？
cues.titleEn: How does voltage make charge measurable?
cues.caption: 悬停由电场力与有效重力平衡决定。
cues.captionEn: Hovering requires electric force to balance effective weight.
cues.zh: 现在给极板加电压。上正下负，电场向下，负电油滴受到向上的电场力。还是这颗油滴：电压太大，它向上走；把电压调到大约一百四十一伏，它停住了。注意，悬停时没有黏滞阻力，电场力才单独平衡有效重力。电场等于电压除以板间距，所以电荷大小等于有效重量乘板间距，再除以悬停电压。本教学试验算得约六点四乘十的负十九次方库仑，没有预先要求它是某个整数倍。接下来先预测：只把同一滴的电荷翻倍，原电压还能让它停住吗？先看原电压，向上的力变大了。要恢复悬停，电压应减半，约七十点五伏。重量、电场和运动，给出了可以检验的联系。
cues.en: Now apply a voltage. A positive upper plate and negative lower plate make the field point down, so a negatively charged drop feels an upward electric force. Follow the same drop. Too much voltage makes it rise; near one hundred forty-one volts, it stops. At rest, viscous drag is zero. The electric force alone balances effective weight. Field strength is voltage divided by plate spacing, so charge magnitude is effective weight times spacing, divided by the balance voltage. This teaching trial gives about six point four times ten to the minus nineteen coulombs, without requiring an integer multiple beforehand. Now predict: if only the charge doubles, can the old voltage still hold the drop? It now pulls too strongly upward. Restoring balance requires half the voltage, about seventy point five volts. Weight, field and motion have given us a testable connection.

cues.title: 什么记录支持电荷一步一步地变？
cues.titleEn: What records support stepwise changes of charge?
cues.caption: 固定计时记录约束电荷的共同增量。
cues.captionEn: Fixed timing records constrain charge increments.
cues.zh: 模型还不能证明电荷是离散的。现在换到密立根一九一三年的原始记录，第六号油滴。同一滴的下落时间保持在约十一点八八秒，上升时间却大幅变化。上升匀速时，电场力既要克服有效重力，又要克服向下的阻力。因此，对同一滴和同一电场，上升时间倒数的变化，正比于电荷变化。这里保留作者校正后的倒数，不把推断出的整数当观测输入。先用前八次变化比较共同步长。绿色点不动，候选刻度改变；一个小步能容纳大约一、三、六步这些变化。把步长加倍，小跳变就对不上。锁定较小的候选，再看最后一次未参与拟合的变化：若从第十二组增加两步，预测倒数约为每秒零点零二三六一。揭开原记录，是零点零二三六四，两者接近。这支持反复出现的小增量，但更细的子步长仍能容纳有限记录，不能靠这张表独自证明最小单位。绝对元电荷还需要阻力校准和多滴比较，现代精确值也不是这次历史测量的精度。
cues.en: A model cannot establish that charge is discrete. Now open Millikan’s original nineteen thirteen records for Drop Number Six. The same drop’s fall time stays near eleven point eight eight seconds, while its rise times change greatly. During steady rising, electric force must overcome both effective weight and downward drag. For the same drop and field, changes in reciprocal rise time are therefore proportional to changes in charge. These are the author’s corrected reciprocals; inferred integers are not supplied as observations. Compare a common increment using the first eight changes. The green points stay fixed while candidate marks move. One small increment accommodates changes of about one, three and six steps. Doubling it misses the small jump. Lock the smaller candidate, then test the final change, which was not used in the fit. Two steps above state twelve predict about zero point zero two three six one per second. Reveal the original record: zero point zero two three six four. They are close. This supports recurring small increments, but finer substeps also accommodate finite data. This table alone cannot prove the smallest unit. Absolute elementary charge also needs drag calibration and comparisons across drops; today’s exact value is not the precision of this historical measurement.

question.zh: 怎样从一颗油滴的运动，推断电荷大小与离散变化？
question.en: How can one drop’s motion reveal charge and its discrete changes?

lead.zh: 先跟踪一个未知电荷的亮点，再用独立历史计时检验共同增量。
lead.en: Track a spot with unknown charge, then test a repeated increment against independent historical timings.

principle.zh: 无场终速约束阻力和有效重量，悬停电压给出电荷；同滴同场时，上升时间倒数的变化正比于电荷变化。
principle.en: No-field terminal speed constrains drag and effective weight; balance voltage gives charge. For one drop in one field, reciprocal-rise-time changes are proportional to charge changes.

question.zh: 同一滴的电荷大小翻倍，要保持悬停，电压怎样改？仅把历史候选步长减半，能否证明这个更小单位不存在？
question.en: If the same drop’s charge doubles, what voltage preserves balance? Can the finite historical records alone rule out half the fitted step?

explanation.zh: 由|q|U/d=W，重量与间距不变时电压减半。更细子步长也能容纳有限记录，不能由一次限定区间的拟合证明不存在更小单位；绝对电荷还依赖校准。
explanation.en: Since |q|U/d=W, fixed weight and spacing require half the voltage. Finer substeps also accommodate finite records, so a bounded search cannot itself prove no smaller unit exists; absolute charge additionally depends on calibration.

translations.前两章是未知电荷的教学试验，不假定电子数。显微镜亮点是散射像，不能直接量油滴直径: The first two chapters are a teaching trial with an unknown charge, not an assumed electron count. The microscope spot is scattered light, not a direct diameter measurement. Slip, buoyancy, viscosity and density enter the inverse calculation. A voltage change starts a new marked trial, integrated over its voltage history.
translations.历史点取自1913年表IV第6号油滴：第1/4列为原始计时，第5列为作者校正的倒: Historical points come from 1913 Table IV, Drop No. 6. Columns 1/4 are raw times; column 5 contains author-corrected reciprocals. Changes are recomputed from column 5, rather than copying the arithmetically inconsistent column 6. The first 8 changes fit the step; the last is a teaching holdout. Finer substeps also accommodate finite records.
translations.这里不从一张表重新精测元电荷。现代e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C是S: This is not a new precision determination of elementary charge from one table. Modern e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C is an SI defining value, not the precision of a 1913 measurement.

director.status: Measured locale word events; original provisional cuts retained in staged package
director.predictionHold: Initial doubled charge held through question, then old-voltage motion, then half voltage at spoken phrase; one physical history. An instantaneously resting non-equilibrium state is not labeled Balanced.
director.finiteDataCounterexample: Show half-step lattice during finer-substep sentence, keeping green records fixed; return to held-out comparison for absolute-unit limitations.

scientificBoundaries.teachingDrop: Free continuous charge input6.4e-19C, notn*e. Bright spot is an optical image, not resolved radius. SI radius/drag/forces and state integrated independently of rendered scale.
scientificBoundaries.forceModel: Effective weight includes buoyancy, first-order Cunningham slip C=1+b/(pr), exact constant-voltage transient solution and deterministic piecewise histories; no Brownian/evaporation/wall corrections. Plate support added on contact; reversing force permits detachment. Velocity safety domain±100m/s is wider than all generated terminal velocities across accepted parameter bounds; no truncation at a typical microscope speed. Physical Stokes/slip interpretation requires low Reynolds number; numerical input bounds are not an experimental validity guarantee.
scientificBoundaries.geometry: Plate cross-section uses common field orientation and separate supply leads; microscope is an explicitly enlarged observation window. Force arrows share a framewise linear scale, all computed from the same state; clipped view reports out-of-view instead of moving point into frame.
scientificBoundaries.historicalIdentity: Table IV DropNo6;22 fall+21 rise readings in13states. Col5 is author-corrected reciprocal, never raw1/t presented as identical. n/n-prime are not record inputs. Col6 inconsistency retained in source and differences independently recomputed from col5.
scientificBoundaries.fit: Onlyfirst8 adjacent absolute corrected reciprocal changes; bounded candidate interval. Fittedk=.005378095890410959 s^-1 with counts6,7,1,3,1,5,4,3. Factor2misses odd steps; factor.5also fits, so neither finite records nor chosen search interval prove minimum charge.
scientificBoundaries.holdout: Final13thstate unfit; conditionaltwo-step prediction .02360619178082192 s^-1 versus fixed .02364. Residual .00003380821917808. Declared teaching partition, not a historical preregistered test, and no invented statistical significance.
scientificBoundaries.absoluteCharge: No claim of reconstructing precisione from one table or its derived radius. Modern exacte is SI definition, not1913precision.
